provenance.notes: Licence page read 2026-11-10: Platform data marked CC0 1.0 (code Apache 2.0); some upstream sources carry their own licences (e.g. ChEMBL CC BY-SA 3.0), listed on the same page. Citation of the latest publication is requested ("please cite"), not required. The GraphQL API page publishes no rate limit; it discourages repeated one-entity-at-a-time querying and points to the dataset downloads for bulk use. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call. Licence and usage questions go to the Open Targets Community.
